verdict.rationale: Weave is an LLM observability/tracing/evaluation platform, not an agent that itself performs tasks using external tools — the 'plug MCP servers in so it can use their tools' story is a category mismatch for this kind of product. The only MCP-related evidence (wandb-weave-docs-20, wandb-weave-probe-4) shows the opposite direction: Weave exposes its own MCP server so other coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) can connect to and use Weave's data/tools, not Weave consuming external MCP servers as a client.
